summary: Finish live Fractal product, component and crate references in documentation, release automation and test tooling

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored-data changes. Internal runtime identifiers and test-only environment markers use the Fractal name.

schema.detail: No serialized schema, registry, message envelope or protocol changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, hash, signature or admission-rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Shipped binary names, public environment variables, existing state paths and migration bridges are unchanged. Release workflow display names and concurrency groups now say Fractal; generated configuration follows its source.

downtime.detail: No service restart or coordinated upgrade is required.

manual.detail: No operator steps. Home Manager option names, release script filenames and existing macOS app paths retain their current compatibility contracts.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; ordinary release rollback remains available.
